description: Work with your church's Planning Center: find, add and update people, add their emails, phone numbers and notes, add them to People workflows, read lists, groups, upcoming events and service plans, and start a workflow when someone is added to People or sends a form.

planning_center_new_check_in_trigger.description: Runs when someone checks in with Planning Center Check-Ins, such as to welcome a first-time guest. Gives you their name, whether they checked in as a regular, guest or volunteer, and the event. Check-ins already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Your Planning Center login must be able to use Check-Ins. More than 100 check-ins between two checks can miss the oldest of them.

output.checked_in_at: When they checked in, such as 2026-03-01T15:04:05Z.
output.event_name: The event they checked in to, such as Sunday Kids.
output.kind: How they checked in: Regular, Guest or Volunteer.
output.name: The full name they checked in under.
output.one_time_guest: Whether they checked in as a one-time guest with no record in People (true or false).
output.person_id: Their ID in Planning Center, for the steps that take a person. Blank for a one-time guest.

planning_center_new_donation_trigger.description: Runs when a gift comes in through Planning Center Giving and goes through, such as to thank the giver. Gives you the amount, how it was given, when, and the giver's name, email and phone number. Gifts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and failed ones never do. Your Planning Center login must be able to see donations in Giving. On a very busy day, more than 100 gifts between two checks can miss the oldest of them.

output.amount: How much was given, such as 25.5.
output.email: The giver's main email address. Blank when there is none.
output.memo: The note the giver added, if any.
output.name: The giver's name. Blank when it isn't known.
output.payment_method: How it was given: card, ach (bank), cash or check.
output.person_id: The giver's ID in Planning Center. Blank for an anonymous gift.
output.phone_number: The giver's main phone number. Blank when there is none.
output.received_at: When it was received, such as 2026-03-01T15:04:05Z.
output.recurring: Whether it's part of a recurring gift (true or false).

planning_center_new_form_submission_trig.description: Runs when someone sends a People form, with who sent it and each answer by its question. Submissions already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.answers: Each answer, keyed by the question's label
output.created_at: When it was created, as an ISO 8601 time
output.person_first_name: The first name of the person who sent the form
output.person_last_name: The last name of the person who sent the form
output.person_name: The name of the person who sent the form
output.verified: True once the person has confirmed their answers

parameters.description: The People form to watch.
parameters.name: form_id

planning_center_new_person_trigger.description: Runs when a person is added to Planning Center People, by hand, by a form, or by another Planning Center product, with their main email address and phone number. People already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.avatar: The address of the person's photo
output.created_at: When it was created, as an ISO 8601 time
output.gender: The gender, such as Male or Female
output.grade: The school grade, for a child
output.inactivated_at: When the person was made inactive, if they were
output.membership: The membership type, such as Member or Visitor
output.name: The full name
output.profile_url: The person's page in Planning Center People
output.updated_at: When it last changed, as an ISO 8601 time
